name: cursor-grit
description: 颗粒噪点质感光标轨迹画布
interaction: Move your cursor across the canvas to scatter grainy, gritty particle trails that accumulate and dissipate over time. The noise-textured particles respond to cursor velocity — faster strokes fling finer grit, while slow drags deposit denser, chunkier clusters. Every gesture leaves a raw, tactile residue that slowly fades like chalk dust on weathered concrete.
